closure_rule: Every frozen native and derivative declaration, and all17 complete subsystem contracts, require independent source-bound native qualification. Scoped implementations, finite case counts and component CI cannot close a full gate.

gates.required: Independent native compilation and linking with complete signatures, effects, resources, ownership, imports/exports and runtime tensor ABI
gates.remaining: Complete the public Tensor ABI, foreign resource provenance, all supported signatures/effects and module/resource graphs. Current native modular compilation and owned ABI3 are a finite CPU foundation.

gates.required: General allocation, storage ownership, aliasing, reference lifetime, persistent execution, scalable capacity and device memory
gates.remaining: Complete external and device allocation, concurrent strong/weak lifetime, custom deleters, arbitrary alias paths, and durable restore. Current owned Tensor/Storage/Version pools and transactional rollback remain bounded by their qualified CPU profile.

gates.required: All upstream dtypes, conversion, promotion, numerical modes, dense/sparse/compressed/nested/quantized/complex layouts and invariants
gates.remaining: Complete dtype promotion, all conversion/rounding modes, ranks, layouts and devices. The scoped BF16 AVX2/AVX512 NaN copy repair is implemented; DEFAULT dispatch and other architectures remain. The new 23-group/2839-case combined candidate requires its own actual run.

gates.required: All 2590 frozen native declarations plus generated variants and required backend/dtype/layout/shape combinations
gates.remaining: Implement and independently qualify every complete contract in the2590 frozen native declarations, all required overloads and generated/backend/dtype/layout variants, and applicable688 derivative declarations. No complete declaration is currently qualified.

gates.required: All view/stride/offset/overlap/indexing semantics, out and inplace variants, alias/version behavior and mutation errors
gates.remaining: Complete all ranks, strides, offsets, overlap, mutation/out variants, dtypes and devices with exact alias/version/history/resource behavior. Current limited view/reshape/as_strided paths retain their original regressions and await the current combined run.

gates.required: Full reverse/forward/higher-order AD, hooks, custom functions, checkpointing, batching and functional transforms
gates.remaining: Implement full forward and higher-order AD, create_graph, hooks, custom functions, checkpointing, batching and functional transforms; complete differentiation for every applicable native declaration. Current first-order reverse AD and public/retained gradients remain a finite subset.

gates.required: Python/C++ frontend object and error behavior, schemas/dispatch/meta execution, overrides and extension registration
gates.remaining: Implement Python/C++ frontend object and exception behavior, schema dispatch/meta execution, overrides, contexts and extension registration. The current bounded binary command interface is the native test/execution interface.

gates.required: Complete modules, parameter/buffer trees, train/eval state, functional APIs, convolution/pooling/normalization/attention/recurrent semantics
gates.remaining: Complete module/parameter/buffer trees, train/eval state, all functional APIs and attention/recurrent/convolution/pooling/normalization modes with backend/dtype/error parity.

gates.required: All optimizers and schedules, parameter groups, grad=None, state dictionaries, serialization, capturable/differentiable and backend modes
gates.remaining: Complete all optimizers and schedulers, state dictionaries/serialization, parameter groups and every capturable/differentiable/backend/dtype/device mode. Current owned SGD/momentum and Adam/AdamW have finite numerical/lifetime qualification.

gates.required: Generators, all distributions, seed/state/device behavior, dropout and deterministic execution controls
gates.remaining: Complete all distributions and device Generators, shared/concurrent state, dropout/backend modes and deterministic execution controls. Current CPU MT19937 code and its131-case current-object/probe qualification remain a finite required subset.

gates.required: Full checkpoint/state serialization, storage alias preservation, formats, map_location, compatibility, interrupted restore and distributed checkpoints
gates.remaining: Implement checkpoint/state formats, storage alias preservation, map_location, cross-version compatibility, interrupted restore and distributed checkpoint behavior.

gates.required: CUDA/ROCm/MPS/XPU devices, allocators/transfers, streams/events, kernels, numerical modes, synchronization and error behavior
gates.remaining: Implement CUDA/ROCm/MPS/XPU device allocation and transfers, streams/events, native kernels, numerical modes, synchronization and errors. The current runtime is Linux x86-64 CPU.

gates.required: Rendezvous/process groups, collectives, async work, failure/timeouts, DDP/FSDP/DTensor and distributed state
gates.remaining: Implement rendezvous/process groups, collectives, asynchronous work, failure/timeouts, DDP/FSDP/DTensor and distributed state.

gates.required: Graph capture, symbolic shapes, decomposition, AOT/compile/export, transformations, lowering, fusion and executable artifact compatibility
gates.remaining: Implement graph capture, symbolic shapes, decomposition, AOT/compile/export, transformations, fusion and executable artifact compatibility. HIA source compilation alone does not implement these PyTorch APIs.

gates.required: Dataset/dataloader, worker/multiprocessing lifecycle, pinning, sampling, reproducibility, failure and cancellation semantics
gates.remaining: Implement Dataset/DataLoader, workers and multiprocessing, pinning, sampling, deterministic replay, failure and cancellation semantics.

gates.required: All upstream-supported platforms/architectures, native packaging, reproducible toolchain, installation, extension and profiling interfaces
gates.remaining: Complete all required architectures/platforms, installation and packaging, extensions and profiling interfaces. Current fixed-toolchain reproduction covers Linux x86-64.

gates.required: Full original test and application acceptance, independent final review, performance/resource/error qualifications and retirement of replaced implementation paths
gates.remaining: Run full original upstream/application/performance/resource/error acceptance and independent review of every gate. Complete the current 23-group/2839-case focused run and migrate all remaining active predecessor consumers before final retirement.

current_runtime_integration.scope: One761-function/15-unit HIA candidate. All22 predecessor groups/2468 cases remain mandatory; Half47 retains every original request and requires explicit actual-Torch outcomes for22 supported multiplications and2 negations while215 remain refused. Half negation adds371 exact-bit cases. Production cases bind one current main image and cold build; Generator131 also executes separately linked current-object probes.
current_runtime_integration.pending_dtype_audit: Scoped BF16 AVX2/AVX512 copy and AVX2 Half multiplication/negation implementations require current761 combined requalification. DEFAULT, other architectures, complete arithmetic/promotion/layout/device semantics and Half AD remain open.
